name: Turboturn Meter
description: Shows your current chain multiplier and next cost. The first time each combat you resolve a card at 3x or higher, gain 1 temporary energy.

name: Bloodwick Lantern
description: The first time each combat you spend 3 or more blood, draw 1 card.

name: Saltwire Clasp
description: Whenever you gain temporary energy, gain 1 block.

name: Inkvein Charm
description: Your first curse each combat costs 1 less to play.

name: Marrowglass Seed
description: At the start of combat, if you have no curse cards in hand, gain 2 chain.

name: Ribcage Talisman
description: The first time each combat you resolve a chain of 4 or more, exhaust 1 random enemy buff.

name: Waxmoon Brooch
description: Whenever you play a 0-cost card, gain 1 blood.

name: Sunless Ambit
description: At the start of each turn, if your chain is 2 or higher, gain 2 temporary energy.

name: Blackthorn Vial
description: Whenever you play a curse, gain 8 block and 1 chain.

name: Nocturne Crown
description: The first time each combat you resolve a card at 5x or higher, draw 2 cards and gain 1 temporary energy.
